subject.title: feat(ledger): instrument review and apply actions

question: Should incomplete immutable action-ledger finalization fail an otherwise successful production review or apply command?
rationale: The patch implements fail-closed finalization after primary success, and choosing audit completeness over degraded availability is a production policy that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Preserve primary outcomes
options.body: Keep ledger failures visible and actionable without invalidating otherwise successful review or apply work.

options.title: Require complete receipts
options.body: Retain fail-closed semantics and explicitly document that incomplete receipts make the production operation unsuccessful.

recommendation.title: Preserve primary outcomes
recommendation.body: Keep ledger failures visible and actionable without invalidating otherwise successful review or apply work.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ledger architecture and own the current integration history.
